name: Automancer
description: Practical AI and workflow automation for UK small businesses. Cut admin, reduce errors, and improve operations with Automancer.

contact.phoneNote: Voicemail line — messages reach a human (Waseem), not a bot menu.
contact.formNote: The form requires JavaScript and a browser security check; agents should prefer email.
contact.responseTime: We promise a meeting within one week of first contact.

enquiryContract.description: Every route to Waseem, which one an agent can complete (email), the fields the form asks for with their limits, and an email template that asks the same questions.

markdownTwins.convention: Every content page is also available as clean Markdown with YAML front matter at the same path plus ".md" (for example /about/ -> /about.md).

fullText.description: Plain-text guide to the site for LLMs and agents.
The complete site content in one plain-text file.

machineReadable.structuredData: Every HTML page embeds one schema.org JSON-LD @graph with absolute @ids.

securityTxt.description: RFC 9116 security.txt: how to report security issues in this site or its content.

machineReadable.legalPagesPolicy: The bodies of /privacy/ and /terms/ are deliberately NOT mirrored in any machine-readable format (transcription drifts silently). Fetch those canonical HTML URLs for their current full text.

policy.crawling: Allowed and encouraged. robots.txt explicitly permits all well-behaved crawlers including AI crawlers; there are no Disallow rules for content.
policy.rateLimits: No formal rate limit. This is a static site on GitHub Pages; keep requests modest and cache responses — payloads change only at deploy time.
policy.authentication: None. Every endpoint listed here is public, static and key-free.
policy.cost: Free to read. No paid API tier exists.
policy.stability: Endpoints are generated at build time from the same sources as the HTML pages; within a schemaVersion at a given path, changes are additive only. The full promise — stable paths, operation ids, service ids and field names, what may change without notice, and the minimum notice a removal gets — is published as data at https://automancer.uk/api/stability.json.

permissions.statement: You may read, index, summarise and quote this content with attribution to Automancer Ltd. Wholesale republication of site content as your own is not permitted without written permission — consistent with our website terms at /terms/.
prohibited: representing this business or its content as your own
